title: Garry Nolan has seen little people and a craft

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says that Garry Nolan, a scientist at Stanford University, has seen some little people, and a craft too. Michels gives no time or place for it. If true, it would mean a well-known scientist had a direct encounter with non-human beings and their vehicle.
